title: Google Ads API Developer Assistant gets major AI agent upgrade
summary: Google Ads API Developer Assistant gets major AI agent upgrade Search Engine Land
body: Google Ads API Developer Assistant gets major AI agent upgrade Search Engine Land
summaryZh: Google Ads API开发者助手迎来重大升级，正式引入AI Agent功能。此次升级使助手不仅能提供代码建议，还能自主执行复杂的API调用任务，显著提升了广告开发者的工作流自动化水平。原始信息显示：Google Ads API Developer Assistant gets major AI agent upgrade Search Engine Land。该消息由Search Engine Land发布，主题为“Google Ads API Developer Assistant gets major AI agent upgrade”。其重要性主要体现在：Google Ads API助手升级为AI Agent，体现了开发工具向自主代理模式的演进。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
